name: birc-utils
description: A collection of utility scripts for bIRC.

scripts.build:hash: node hash/scripts/prepare-runtime-data.js && esbuild hash/src/birc-hash.js --bundle --platform=browser --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=linked --banner:js='var setTimeout = function (callback, milliseconds) { return birc.setTimeout(callback, milliseconds); };' --outfile=hash/birc-hash.js && node hash/scripts/normalize-legal-comments.js
